name: Fermi Dialetheia

phase_0.boundary_condition: The observable horizon of the light cone

VINIT.justification: The pre-biotic state of the universe before the emergence of observers

TANCH.justification: The final thermodynamic equilibrium that bounds all cosmic activity

AFWD.justification: The forward transformation from inert matter to self-replicating life

AREV.justification: The reverse morphism where biological complexity collapses back into entropy

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of scientific discoveries and energy mastery

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-recognition of the observer as a necessary condition for the observation

FSPLIT.justification: The branching point where a civilization either transcends its planetary cradle or perishes

FFUSE.justification: The reunification of outcomes where both success and failure result in no detectable signal

EVALT.justification: The affirmative branch where life successfully colonizes the galaxy

EVALF.justification: The negative branch where life fails to survive its own technological power

ENGAGR.justification: The paradice where civilizations exist but remain undetectable by choice or physics

IFIX.justification: The permanent irreversible record of a civilization's existence or demise

phase_3.void_description: A universe without life or observers
phase_3.true_description: A galaxy teeming with detectable technological activity
phase_3.false_description: A galaxy devoid of life due to universal failure
phase_3.both_description: The Fermi Paradox: the simultaneous presence of life and the absence of evidence

steps.domain_action: The universe begins in a state of high entropy without observers
Life emerges and recognizes its own existence within the cosmos
Biological evolution drives the increase of local complexity
Intelligence develops tools and begins to manipulate energy
The civilization reaches the critical threshold of the Great Filter
The civilization survives and begins interstellar expansion
The expansion leaves permanent Dyson structures in the galactic record
The civilization collapses due to resource exhaustion or war
The ruins of the civilization decay into planetary dust
The paradox holds both outcomes in a state of observational tension
The observer perceives only the silence of the empty sky
The cosmic horizon closes as expansion exceeds the speed of light

phase_5.memory_mechanism: The cosmic microwave background and galactic structure
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The rate of stellar evolution and planetary formation

phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The information gain of the observer is balanced by the dissipation of the star
